messages.subject: Harrow Precision / Stratton Energy — Supply Agreement first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alistair,

Further to the agreed Heads of Terms, please find attached the first draft of the Supply Agreement and schedules. The commercial framework follows the HoT: 5-year initial term, £3.2m minimum annual commitment, volume discounts, 45-day payment and a 24-month warranty.

We look forward to your mark-up.

Kind regards,
James Osei

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
